anomalies.observed: The assembly note says to short R10 twice for Core2/CoreS3. R10 connects PWM1_C2 to PWM1, while R12 is the corresponding jumper from PWM2_C2 to PWM2.
anomalies.expected: The Core2/CoreS3 instruction should identify one jumper for each PWM channel: R10 and R12. Repeating R10 leaves the PWM2 channel without its intended Core2/CoreS3 mapping if the note is followed.

evidence.quote: "Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3"; R10 is drawn between PWM1_C2 and PWM1, and R12 between PWM2_C2 and PWM2. (Sheet 1, page 1)
R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: Following the note literally can leave PWM2 disconnected from the Core2/CoreS3 bus pin, preventing control of the second PWM servo.

parsed.summary: The schematic’s Core2/CoreS3 jumper instruction repeats R10 instead of naming the PWM2 jumper R12. The jumper topology indicates that this can leave the second PWM channel unmapped when the instruction is followed.
